description: ZDD hooks. SessionStart injects the adopter repo's agent index (the auto-load); PreToolUse fences the generated artifacts against hand edits. Both are opt-ins recorded by `bootstrap` in the adopter's zdd/config.json (`hooks.autoLoad`, `hooks.fence`) and both are silent no-ops in a repo that has not opted in. Scripts are reached via ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} only — Codex sets the same variable — as one command string, the form both hosts' hook schemas share, so this one file serves both.
